name: Fox Proframe Helmet
opinion: Light, well-ventilated, and the MIPS gives confidence. Fits true to size.

name: Five Ten Freerider Pro
opinion: Best flat pedal shoes I've used. Grip is unreal, and they survive everything.

name: Oakley Radar EV
opinion: Great optics and coverage. Prizm trail lens is perfect for forest riding.

name: Endura MT500 Burner
opinion: Tough, breathable, and the pockets actually hold stuff. Good for long days.

name: Topeak Mini 20 Pro
opinion: Has every tool I need on the trail. Small enough to forget it's in my pack.

name: SIS GO Gel
opinion: Easy to eat on the bike, doesn't upset my stomach. Go-to for long rides.

name: Garmin Edge 540
opinion: Reliable, accurate, and the battery lasts forever. Climb Pro feature is genuinely useful.

name: Camelbak M.U.L.E.
opinion: Carries everything I need for a long ride without bouncing. 3L is enough for most days.
